title: feat(spec): the customizations read's contributions declare a nav kind, with an entry shape per kind
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi966GpYAicps1ruJvFmeXfZw)_
Fixes #27928

Part of #28722 (its Wanted 3, the server slice that serves the `nav` kind, stays open).

Ruling-ref: 6566915346
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — a served response member no author writes, and its `nav` kind is not served yet, so there is nothing to teach; the API docs page names `contributions` in this diff and the server slice that serves the kind owns the rest

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：spec 里 `GET /packages/:id/customizations` 的 `contributions` 加第三种 `nav`（别的包往本包应用里加的导航项），条目形状按种类分：字段/流程条目照旧带 `object`，导航条目带 `app`、可选 `group`、导航项 id（`name`）和 `packageId`。
- 为什么改：裁决 E（6566915346，「同意」）：Studio 要把别的包加进 HotCRM 分组的导航项灰显并标出来源，服务端 #28722 第三项要先有这份协议。
- 风险与回滚：纯加宽，今天服务端发的字段/流程条目原样解析；`nav` 臂标了 [PLANNED — not yet served]，服务端还不发；运行时只改了一处本地类型标注（编译所需，行为不变）；回滚就是撤掉这个 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`（contributions 的两臂和排序说明）、`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`（新测试和 PLANNED 钉）、`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`（一行类型收窄）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`，预期 35 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The customizations read's `contributions` member gains the `nav` kind the ruling binds (letter E): a navigation item another installed package's `navigationContributions` add to an app the base owns. **Declared ahead of its producer** (ADR-0049): the runtime lists no `nav` entry until the server slice of #28722 (Wanted 3) reads the navigation-contribution registry.

- **`GetPackageCustomizationsResponseSchema.contributions`** (`packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.zod.ts`) is now an array of `z.discriminatedUnion('kind', …)` with two strict arms:
  - the `field` / `flow` arm: `kind`, `object`, `name`, `packageId`, the same members and describes as before, so it accepts exactly what the member accepted (CONTROL tests); the arm gains a one-line describe;
  - the `nav` arm: `kind: 'nav'`, `app` (the base-owned app), an optional `group` (the group the contribution targets, as declared), `name` (the nav item's id) and `packageId`. Its describe opens `[PLANNED — not yet served]` and names ADR-0049; the tracker ids are in an adjacent `//` comment only.
- The member describe names the three kinds, the per-kind shape, and an order: the `field` and `flow` entries first, in their existing order (object, kind, name, package), then the `nav` entries by app, group (an entry with no group first), name and package. `counts.contributions` still counts items.
- The schema docblock says "exactly three kinds", spells the per-kind shape, and carries a DECLARED AHEAD OF ITS PRODUCER (ADR-0049) paragraph stating what the producer MUST do when it serves the kind: read the same `appNavContributions` registry the navigation fold reads, never join by name, list no disabled package's contributions, and add no key to any nav item. The schema-level describe names the third kind as not yet served.
- Regenerated: `content/docs/references/api/package-lifecycle.mdx` (the union renders as two nested shapes), and the strictness ledger count `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/api.md` (486 to 487, the new strict arm).
- Docs: `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx` names the `contributions` list beside overrides, extensions and switched-off items, and says the `nav` kind is declared and not yet served.
- Changeset `.changeset/27928-customizations-contributions-nav-kind.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, with both declaration lines.
- `packages/spec/variant-docs.json`: a governed entry for the new union (key `kind:nav`), bound to `content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`, which names the list and its `nav` kind. The gate's walker reads only literal arms, so the `field` / `flow` arm's `z.enum` is not in the key.
- **Forced consumer edit:** `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts` `readBaseContributions` now types its local entries as the `contributions` entry type with the `nav` arm excluded (a TypeScript `Exclude` over `{ kind: 'nav' }`). Without it, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` exits 2 (TS2339 `object` on the union, twice, and TS7053 on the `kindOrder` index, twice). Type-only: the producer lists the same `field` and `flow` entries, and reading the nav registry stays the server slice's. No runtime changeset: the edit is a type annotation and a comment inside a non-exported function, so no published byte moves.

**No liveness row.** Measured: `packages/spec/liveness/` governs metadata types (its README: the source of truth is the metadata-type registry), and no ledger names this API response or its member (`git grep` over `packages/spec/liveness` finds neither). The declared-not-served channel for a wire schema is the describe marker, pinned in the test.

## Why

The ruling (6566915346, letter E, the maintainer's 「同意」) serves the contributed navigation entries as a third kind of the landed `contributions` member, so Studio can draw them greyed with their package (#27356 row 20) from one served read, never a client-side join on names. The server slice needs this declaration first.

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/api/package-lifecycle.test.ts`, new: CONTROL, a field and a flow entry parse and are preserved; CONTROL, a field entry still requires `object`; a nav entry with its group parses and is preserved; a nav entry without a group parses and gains none; a nav entry carrying `object` is refused (`unrecognized_keys`); a field entry carrying `app` and a flow entry carrying `group` are refused (`unrecognized_keys`); a nav entry without `app`, `name` or `packageId` is refused (`invalid_type` at that path); an unknown kind is refused (`invalid_union` at `kind`); the nav arm's describe opens the planned marker, names ADR-0049 and carries no tracker id; the member says the kind is not yet served and the field / flow arm carries no marker.
- No existing test was edited.

## Acceptance notes

- Three spellings the ruling left to this card are in the report's open questions: the order of `nav` entries, `group` as declared (named even when the app declares no such group), and one entry per item of the contribution's `items` (a contributed group's children are not entries of their own).
- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` describes the customizations read as listing "overrides, extensions and switched-off items" and has not named `contributions` since that member landed. A governed surface, not touched here; noted for the seat (carrier: the server slice that serves the kind).
- The pending `.changeset/28722-customizations-contributions.md` says navigation entries are "not in this list yet", which is still true; it is not edited.
- The runtime route-ledger note for this route names the fields and flows only, which is still what is served; the server slice extends it.

## Verification

See the readings above. The PR stays a draft; the seat runs the contract review.
